text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer has ended.
If I were to sum up this summer in a single word—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Would you not call this
'The Summer of the Overlord's Awakening'?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Interacting with El Condor Pasa... with El, was truly meaningful.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to her, I've been freed from the curse
of believing that 'a true conqueror must win by a huge margin.'

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I will no longer
fear either chaos or confusion!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I shall endure everything with grit, and from within that mud,
I shall seize a truly beautiful jewel.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Even if they mark me, I'll just charge right down the center
and kick them out of the way. Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The path has been revealed. From now on, T.M. Opera O
will not merely be magnificent—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a king both beautiful and arrogantly powerful,
she strides down the path of supremacy.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I am no longer a mere Overlord.
Indeed, you could say—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I am the Overlord who always wants to live on the edge!
A narrow victory is plenty! A narrow margin is my truest friend!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, Trainer-kun.
Praise me by my new name.
choice_data_list: Yo! Supreme Ruler on the brink!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha!
Indeed, I am always on the precipice!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: This thrill, feeling like you could tumble off at any second...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I feel like there's got to be
a better way to address it, though...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Well, no matter! At the Japan Cup,
I shall show them the ultimate, tough Overlord!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
TM Opera O turned her back
and strode away with magnificent confidence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I felt as though I could almost see the words "End of the Century" written across her back.
